version.description: Version of the configuration format. Must be 1.

language.description: Language of the content (BCP 47). Default: en.

basePath.description: URL path where the site is deployed, such as / or /docs/. Default: /.

url.description: Absolute origin of the site, such as https://example.com, used for canonical URLs and the sitemap. Must not contain a path; use basePath instead.

logo.description: Logo image file, relative to the configuration file.

favicon.description: Favicon file, relative to the configuration file.

socialImage.description: Image used for social previews, relative to the configuration file. Requires url.

robots.description: robots policy: none (no robots.txt), allow, or disallow. Default: none.

footer.description: Footer text displayed on every page.

headerLinks.description: Links displayed on the right side of the header.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the link.

icon.description: Optional emoji or text glyph displayed before the link text.

output.description: Output directory, relative to the configuration file. Default: _site.

cacheDirectory.description: Package cache directory, relative to the configuration file. Default: a per-user cache directory, or the DOCGEN_CACHE environment variable.

packages.description: NuGet packages whose APIs are documented.

id.description: NuGet package identifier. Omit when path is a folder to discover all packages in that folder.

version.description: Package version: an exact version (1.2.3), a NuGet version range ([1.0,2.0)) or a floating version (1.*, *, *-*). The highest matching version is used. Default: the latest stable version.

source.description: Package source URL or name from NuGet.Config. Default: the sources from NuGet.Config.

path.description: Local .nupkg file, or folder containing .nupkg files, relative to the configuration file. In a folder, the highest version matching 'version' is used for each package identifier. Omit 'id' to discover all packages at the root of the folder. When set, no feed is queried.

targetFrameworks.description: Target framework folders to document, such as net8.0. Default: all.

assemblies.description: Assembly file names to document, such as Contoso.dll. Default: all managed assemblies.

defineConstants.description: Preprocessor symbols defined when compiling a source package, in addition to the symbols of the target framework, such as the symbols its MSBuild targets define in the consuming project. Default: none.

references.description: Packages whose metadata and XML documentation are used for inherited documentation and cross-references, without publishing their APIs.

root.description: Directory containing the Markdown pages, relative to the configuration file.

assets.description: Additional files or directories copied as-is, relative to the content root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns of Markdown files to ignore, relative to the content root.

editUrl.description: URL of the editor of a page, containing {path}: the path of the Markdown file relative to the content root (https://github.com/contoso/docs/edit/main/docs/{path}). Default: no edit link.

include.description: Patterns of namespaces or types to document. Default: all visible APIs.

exclude.description: Patterns of namespaces, types or members to exclude.

xrefs.description: Links to documentation of symbols that are not part of the configured packages. Default: System and Microsoft namespaces link to Microsoft Learn. An empty list disables external links.

namespace.description: Namespace prefix handled by this entry, such as System.

url.description: URL template. {uid} is replaced by the lowercase documentation ID without its prefix.

allowInvalidCref.description: Report unresolved or ambiguous cref links as warnings instead of errors. The link text is still rendered without a link. Default: false.

severity.description: Severity overrides: code to error, warning, info or none.

enabled.description: Generate links to source files using PDBs and Source Link. Default: true.

symbolServers.description: Symbol servers (SSQP, such as https://symbols.nuget.org/download/symbols) queried for PDBs that are not in the package. Default: none.
